title: Shah Optimization
description: A blazing fast, highly tweaked, and deeply optimized Fabric modpack for competitive play. High FPS, OptiFine features, and technical utility without compromises.
body:
# 🚀 Shah Optimization

Welcome to **Shah Optimization**, the ultimate, finely-tuned Fabric modpack built for players who demand a **blazing fast, highly tweaked, and deeply optimized** Minecraft experience without any compromises. --- ## ⚙️ Custom Configurations No need to spend hours adjusting options. The pack comes pre-tweaked out of the box with custom configuration files matching what advanced and competitive players actually prefer: * **Dark Mode Enabled:** The Dark Mode resource pack is pre-installed and auto-enabled for a sleek, eye-friendly experience from the moment you launch the game. * **Competitive FOV (90):** Field of View is set to **90** by default, providing the perfect balance between peripheral awareness and target precision preferred by competitive players. * **Pro-Style Click Bindings:** To enhance reaction speed, the **Attack** and **Use** functions are swapped (Left-Click to Use, Right-Click to Attack), a common setup for high-level technical play. * **Damage Tilt Disabled:** Screen shake is completely disabled when you take damage, ensuring your aim and vision remain perfectly steady during intense combat. * **Boat Item View Fix:** A custom fix ensures your maps and held items do not disappear or clip while sailing, maintaining perfect visibility on the water. * **Optimized Game Options:** Annoying features like Auto-Jump and View Bobbing are turned off by default. Render distance is locked at a stable 10 chunks, Biome Blend is set to 0 for instant chunk rendering, and the dark Mojang loading background is enabled to save your eyes. * **Instant Zoom Transitions:** [Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify) is pre-configured to use "instant" zoom-in and zoom-out transitions instead of smooth animations, providing the ultra-snappy feedback preferred by competitive players. * **Aggressive Performance Presets:** [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) options are highly optimized with "FAST" leaves and weather qualities, vignette disabled, and full entity and block-face culling enabled out-of-the-box. * **Clean & Dynamic HUDs:** [BetterF3](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterf3) is data-stripped out of bulky, unnecessary debug clutter, leaving you with a clean, color-coded dashboard. [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap) is set up with both radar and automated deathpoint logging active from the start. --- ## 💎 OptiFine Parity Switching from OptiFine? You won't miss a single feature. This pack offers complete OptiFine features but with vastly superior performance and modern compatibility: * **Cinematic Zoom:** Smooth, customizable zooming functionality powered by **[Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify)**. * **Shaders Support:** Flawless, high-FPS shader execution via **[Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris)**. * **Connected Textures:** Beautiful, seamless glass and block connections using **[Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity)**. * **Custom Entity Models (CEM):** Full support for advanced OptiFine resource packs, custom mob models, and random textures thanks to **[EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/emf)** and **[ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/etf)**. * **Dynamic Lights:** Handheld and dropped items illuminate your surroundings dynamically with **[LambDynamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights)**. --- ## ⚡ Key Features ### 🏎️ Performance Stack We don't just add Sodium; we optimize the entire engine. This pack features a meticulously tested stack of performance mods that target CPU overhead, memory leaks, chunk generation, and GPU utilization. * **Core Rendering:** Powered by **[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)** and enhanced with **[Reese's Sodium Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/reeses-sodium-options)** and **[Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra)** for granular control over your graphics. * **Logic & Physics:** **[Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)** optimizes game physics and chunk loading, while **[FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferritecore)** drastically reduces RAM usage. * **Modern Tweaks:** **[ModernFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix)**, **[Bad Optimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/bad-optimizations)**, and **[ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast)** rewrite flawed vanilla code to eliminate micro-stutters. * **Culling & Math:** **[Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling)** and **[MoreCulling](https://modrinth.com/mod/moreculling)** ensure your PC only renders what you can actually see, while underlying processes are accelerated by technical frameworks. * **Networking:** **[Krypton](https://modrinth.com/mod/krypton)**, **[Noxesium](https://modrinth.com/mod/noxesium)**, and **[Packet Fixer](https://modrinth.com/mod/packet-fixer)** optimize data streaming, reducing server-side lag and rubber-banding. ### 🛠️ Technical Tools For the technical players, redstone engineers, and mega-builders, this pack integrates the gold standard of utility mods. * **Automation & Schematics:** Fully equipped with **[Litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica)** and **[Tweakeroo](https://modrinth.com/mod/tweakeroo)** (powered by **[MaLiLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/malilib)**) for advanced building, blueprinting, and block placement. * **Precision Placement:** **[Accurate Block Placement Reborn](https://modrinth.com/mod/accurate-block-placement-reborn)** ensures you never misplace a block during high-speed building. * **Navigation:** **[Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap)** and **[Xaero's World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map)** keep you oriented with beautiful, lightweight, and customizable radar interfaces. ### 🌐 Multiplayer & QoL Play your way, on any server, with maximum convenience. * **Cross-Version Compatibility:** **[ViaFabricPlus](https://modrinth.com/mod/viafabricplus)** allows you to connect to almost any Minecraft server version seamlessly. * **Proximity Chat & Audio:** Experience crystal-clear, directional in-game voice communication with **[Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-voice-chat)** combined with realistic acoustic echoes from **[Sound Physics Remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered)**. * **Inventory Management:** **[Roughly Enough Items (REI)](https://modrinth.com/mod/rei)** and **[Client Sort](https://modrinth.com/mod/clientsort)** make recipe viewing and chest organization effortless. * **In-Game Content Downloader:** **[Resourcify](https://modrinth.com/mod/resourcify)** and **[VTDownloader](https://modrinth.com/mod/vtdownloader)** let you browse and install resource packs, shaders, and data packs directly from Modrinth without ever leaving your game. --- ## 📦 Mod Overview Here is a glimpse of the powerful components running under the hood: | Category | Highlighted Mods | | :--- | :--- | | **OptiFine Features** | [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris), [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity), [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/emf), [ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/etf), [Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify), [LambDynamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights) | | **Performance** | [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium), [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferritecore), [ModernFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix), [Bad Optimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/bad-optimizations), [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast), [Noisium](https://modrinth.com/mod/noisium), [ScalableLux](https://modrinth.com/mod/scalablelux) | | **Utilities** | [Litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica), [Tweakeroo](https://modrinth.com/mod/tweakeroo), [FreeCam](https://modrinth.com/mod/freecam), [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap) / [World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map), [BetterF3](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterf3), [Gamma Utils](https://modrinth.com/mod/gamma-utils) | | **Interface & QoL** | [REI](https://modrinth.com/mod/rei), [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin), [Shulker Box Tooltip](https://modrinth.com/mod/shulkerbox-tooltip), [Simple Armor Hud](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-armor-hud), [Controlling](https://modrinth.com/mod/controlling), [Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks) | | **Libraries** | [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api), [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config), [YACL](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl), [Architectury](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api) | --- ## ⚠️ Server Warning > **IMPORTANT:** This modpack contains powerful utility and technical mods (such as *FreeCam*, *Tweakeroo*, *Litematica*, and *Accurate Block Placement*). While these are excellent for single-player worlds and technical survival servers, **some public or competitive multiplayer servers may consider them an unfair advantage or ban them entirely.** > > 👉 **Please double-check the server rules and ensure all included mods are allowed before joining any multiplayer server to prevent accidental bans.** --- ## ⚖️ License > This project is licensed under the [Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/). --- ## ⚠️ Server Warning > **IMPORTANT:** This modpack contains powerful utility mods. **Please double-check the server rules and ensure all included mods are allowed before joining any multiplayer server.** --- __Disclaimer:__ _All rights belong to their respective mod developers.
